record_type: static source audit before numerical recipe

observations.statement: At each cell the unmasked vocabulary vector is D(Rs+b), where R has shape c_id by c. Default c_id=16,c=48 gives rank(DR)<=16 and ambient instantaneous kernel dimension>=32. Neither lower rank of the actually reachable state manifold nor observability from multiple times is determined by this statement.

Native forward records lens(s[t-1]) before numbered update t when t mod k=0; trace frames index0 is seed and index t is post-update/post-hook. scripts/scan.py applies scanner.lens to trace frames, so its displayed step labels align to those post-update states.

scanner.lens suppresses PAD at -10000, computes softmax, and returns only top token and maximum probability. The renderer additionally maps categories/confidence to colors and rounds confidence to2decimals; the standard JSON retains selected top tokens, not probabilities or full state.

scanner.py cautions this is no causal proof but says readout is trained only at the output cell. That statement misses optional school supervision at nonempty input cells and image-lens supervision in the cartilla trainer.

README figure helper maps centered 48-channel state to3PCA axes, rescales by 2nd/98th quantiles and clips; norm uses90thquantile and clips. These displays are lossy and data-dependent, not a calibrated physical activity or complete mechanism measurement.

README claims every reasoning step decodable and interpretable by construction. Applying the actual readout everywhere is implemented, but completeness and semantic causal faithfulness need separate intervention and competence evidence.

thinking_gif reads raw lens softmax without suppressing PAD, unlike scanner.lens and returned final logits. With every non-PAD score below zero, PAD can be the displayed winner. The proposed generator correction delegates to scanner.lens; previously committed images are historical and will not be relabeled as regenerated without the unavailable original checkpoint.

hypotheses_unchanged: Historical H1 remains closed and not supported.
Assigned native weights can test mechanism possibility and measurement contracts; they cannot establish mechanisms of learned role reasoning.
Any future learned null-space intervention is an explicitly conditional state intervention and may leave the training manifold.
